tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Profile of an X (Twitter) account: name, bio, followers, following, post count, verification, creation date. Costs 18 credits.

tools.name: get_user_tweets
tools.description: Latest posts of an X account (its Posts tab). Costs 15 credits per post returned.

tools.name: search_tweets
tools.description: Search X posts. Supports X search operators in the query (from:, to:, lang:, min_faves:, since:, until:, -filter:replies). Costs 15 credits per post returned.

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Find X accounts by name or keyword. Costs 18 credits per account returned.

tools.name: get_tweet
tools.description: One X post with its text, author, counts (likes, reposts, replies, quotes, views) and media. Costs 15 credits.

tools.name: get_tweet_replies
tools.description: Replies under an X post (its conversation). Costs 15 credits per reply returned.

tools.name: get_tweet_quotes
tools.description: Posts that quote an X post. Costs 15 credits per quote returned.

tools.name: get_tweet_retweeters
tools.description: Accounts that reposted (retweeted) an X post. Costs 1 credit per account returned.

tools.name: get_followers
tools.description: Followers of an X account, newest first. Costs 1 credit per follower returned.

tools.name: get_following
tools.description: Accounts an X account follows, newest first. Costs 1 credit per account returned.

tools.name: check_follow
tools.description: Does one X account follow another? Returns both directions. Costs 50 credits.

tools.name: check_interaction
tools.description: Did an account repost, reply to or quote a given X post? Built for giveaway, airdrop and quest verification. For reply and quote, min_tags requires that many @mentions in the text. Costs 50 credits.

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Trending topics on X, worldwide or for a country. Costs 100 credits.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Credits left on your XCROP key: plan allowance, used, remaining and top-up balance. Free.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_user, get_user_tweets, search_tweets, get_tweet, get_tweet_replies, get_tweet_quotes, get_tweet_retweeters, check_interaction · Public sink: get_user, get_user_tweets, search_tweets, get_tweet, get_tweet_replies, get_tweet_quotes, get_tweet_retweeters, check_interaction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_user, get_user_tweets, search_tweets, get_tweet, get_tweet_replies, get_tweet_quotes, get_tweet_retweeters, check_interaction · Public sink: get_user, get_user_tweets, search_tweets, get_tweet, get_tweet_replies, get_tweet_quotes, get_tweet_retweeters, check_interaction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
